invented.quote: The supply boat has stopped coming. The lamp still has to burn every night.
invented.why: The brief only states the game is about seeing a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, with no mention of a supply boat or keeping the lamp burning.

invented.quote: every choice you make costs something someone else needed.
invented.why: The brief does not describe the specific gameplay mechanics or the consequences of player choices.

invented.quote: with people who had never heard of it
invented.why: The brief says the creator took the game to 2 conventions, not whether the people who played it there had heard of it before.

invented.quote: Any rule that confused people or made the game drag got changed, and then we played it again.
invented.why: The brief gives the number of playtest sessions and testers, but does not mention what happened during playtesting or how rules were changed.

invented.quote: What you'd be backing is three years of real players at real tables.
invented.why: The brief says playtesting started in 2023, without specifying the current year or that the testing spanned three years.

invented.quote: I'll post an update every month until the game is in your hands. That includes the months when the news isn't good.
invented.why: The brief says nothing about the creator's schedule or commitment for posting campaign updates.

invented.quote: If we don't reach $28,000, no one is charged, and this game doesn't get printed.
invented.why: The brief does not specify whether the crowdfunding campaign uses an all-or-nothing funding model or if the creator has other ways to print the game.
The brief does not mention a kitchen table or where the prototype is kept.
